body: JayArr, 2026-11-17: 'Never is a strong word. Let's not completely rule it out for now… Lexicon MD says what my words mean.' Applied: the quantum row and CLAUDE.md now use constraint 29's own wording (not shown yet, rather than never). Candidates (§4) and publishing rules (§5) keep their own labels.
plain: framework/lexicon.md says what his words mean. Quantum physics isn't ruled out: it can't yet carry a claim about minds.
